title: Forest cover by country
description: Share of each country's land covered by forest.

source.dataset: World Development Indicators (AG.LND.FRST.ZS), from UN FAO Global Forest Resources Assessment

howToRead: Counts land with trees taller than 5 meters covering more than 10% of the area, including planted forests.
caveats: A country can lose old-growth forest while gaining plantations and show little net change.
